ideas.canonical_en: He claims a VC just signed a term sheet, but it's actually a pizza coupon.
ideas.hook: Just closed a seed round with a top‑tier VC—valuation's through the roof.
ideas.twist: The term sheet is a pizza coupon from a local shop.

ideas.canonical_en: He claims his AI writes the scripts, but it’s just ChatGPT on his phone
ideas.hook: Our proprietary AI writes 100% of our copy in seconds.
ideas.twist: The AI is actually me copy‑pasting from a public chatbot.

ideas.canonical_en: He claims his sunrise meditation fuels a billion-dollar vision, but he's just scrolling memes.
ideas.hook: I start my day at 4:30 AM with a power meditation that aligns my empire.
ideas.twist: Actually I'm just watching cat memes on my phone.

ideas.canonical_en: He claims his sunrise meditation fuels a billion-dollar vision, but he's just scrolling memes.
ideas.hook: I start my day at 4:30 AM with a power meditation that aligns my empire.
ideas.twist: Actually I'm just watching cat memes on my phone.

ideas.canonical_en: He announces a breakthrough AI tool, but the 'AI' is a toaster.
ideas.hook: Launching our AI‑driven platform that will automate every task.
ideas.twist: It's just a toaster I named 'AI‑Toast'.

backlog.canonical_en: He boasts about scaling the team, but his only employee is a rubber chicken.
backlog.hook: We're hiring top talent who can pivot faster than the market.
backlog.twist: My only employee is a rubber chicken named 'Pivot'.
backlog.visual_gag: Rubber chicken with a name tag on a desk.

backlog.canonical_en: He says his office has 5‑star views, but he's on a couch in a laundry room.
backlog.hook: My office overlooks the skyline—clouds of opportunity everywhere.
backlog.setup: Describing high‑rise office with panoramic view.
backlog.twist: I'm actually on a couch in the apartment laundry room.
backlog.visual_gag: Couch with laptop, laundry machines in background, window showing brick wall.

backlog.canonical_en: He says his board meetings are packed, but the board is just his houseplants.
backlog.hook: Our weekly boardroom is always full of visionary leaders.
backlog.setup: Board meeting with key stakeholders discussing growth.
backlog.twist: The only attendees are two succulents.
backlog.visual_gag: Succulents in tiny chairs around a conference table.

backlog.canonical_en: He claims his follower count is soaring, but the screen shows 0 likes.
backlog.hook: My LinkedIn followers exploded overnight—thousands of CEOs follow me.
backlog.twist: My latest post has zero likes and zero comments.
backlog.visual_gag: Phone screen with LinkedIn post showing 0 likes.

backlog.canonical_en: He boasts about payroll automation, but his paycheck is a doodle of a dollar sign.
backlog.hook: Our payroll system runs itself, paying every team member on time.
backlog.twist: My last paycheck was a doodle of a dollar sign on a napkin.

backlog.canonical_en: He pitches a non‑existent startup to imaginary investors over coffee
backlog.hook: I just closed a $2M seed round on a handshake.
backlog.setup: Investors loved my SaaS vision, the traction, and the runway.
backlog.twist: The handshake was with a barista and the runway is a napkin sketch.
backlog.visual_gag: CEO shaking hands with a coffee barista, laptop showing a blank spreadsheet

backlog.canonical_en: He unveils a revolutionary app that’s just a placeholder page
backlog.hook: Today we launch the beta of our AI‑driven platform.
backlog.setup: Our users will automate their workflows with one click.
backlog.twist: The ‘beta’ page says ‘Coming Soon’ and redirects to a Google search.
backlog.visual_gag: CEO clicking a ‘Launch’ button on a laptop, screen shows a 404 page

backlog.canonical_en: He wakes at 5 to build an empire but his office is a kitchen table
backlog.hook: I wake up at five because empires don't build themselves.
backlog.setup: I start my day with a power workout, a strategic review, and a zero‑email inbox.
backlog.twist: My office is my kitchen table and my inbox is empty because I have no emails.
backlog.visual_gag: Tie‑clad CEO doing push‑ups beside a toaster, laptop showing a blank desktop

backlog.canonical_en: He announces a massive bonus then checks his empty bank app
backlog.hook: This quarter we hit 200% of target, bonuses are coming.
backlog.setup: I just transferred the profit share to every employee's account.
backlog.twist: The only account that got the transfer is my savings jar labeled 'future office'.
backlog.visual_gag: CEO looking at phone notification $0, jar of coins on desk

backlog.canonical_en: He tells the landlord he’s scaling to a 5‑person office that’s actually his couch
backlog.hook: We’re expanding to a 5‑person office next month.
backlog.setup: The lease includes a conference room, private pods, and a coffee bar.
backlog.twist: The ‘office’ is the living room couch and the ‘conference room’ is a TV stand.
backlog.visual_gag: CEO showing a crayon floorplan on a napkin to landlord via video call

backlog.canonical_en: He hosts a board meeting with empty chairs and pretends to take minutes
backlog.hook: Our weekly boardroom sync is locked in for 9 am sharp.
backlog.setup: I brief my leadership team on quarterly KPIs, growth hacks, and next‑gen tech.
backlog.twist: The boardroom is just me talking to a whiteboard and a potted plant.
backlog.visual_gag: CEO standing at a conference table with a lone cactus as 'team'

backlog.canonical_en: He posts a glossy LinkedIn update while his laptop battery is at 2%
backlog.hook: Just closed a partnership that will double our ARR.
backlog.setup: I’m live‑streaming the announcement to 10k followers, all eyes on the growth chart.
backlog.twist: The ‘growth chart’ is a hand‑drawn doodle on a napkin.
backlog.visual_gag: Phone showing livestream, messy bedroom background, chart is a stick figure
